_comment: Score and vintage bands. None of this is in the AECB payload -- the payload
delivers score.DataIndex (the number), score.DataRange (an AECB band letter)
and score.FHScoreBand (the FH band code). The cut-offs and the letter->label
mapping are policy configuration and live here.
The screen renders the delivered band; it does not recompute it. The scale
geometry below exists only to position the gauge marker.
Each band runs from its `from` to the NEXT band's `from` (the last runs to
scale.max) -- scoring.gauge() derives zone ends that way, so there is no
`to` field to fall out of step with.

aecb_ranges._comment: score.DataRange letter -> AECB descriptive band. Confirm against the AECB scorecard spec before relying on these labels.

vintage_bands._comment: Bureau history length in months -> AECB vintage band B1-B4. A configured policy mapping; the screen renders the band, it does not derive the cut-offs.

_applications_90d_comment: Section 08 pill: the delivered contractsTotalSummary.Applications90D at or above 'red' is red, at or above 'amber' amber, otherwise green. FH credit policy, not payload. Required whole numbers, amber no higher than red.
_closed_window_comment: Section 07: a closed facility whose ClosedDate falls within this many months before the report date is listed under 'Closed · last N months'; older or undated closures go to 'beyond'. FH presentation policy, not payload. Required: a missing, zero or invalid value stops the render.
_validity_comment: Report look-back window in days, shown as the validity meter in the top bar (aecb/render/shell.py).
